article.title: Microsoft推出MAI Image 2.7圖像編輯預覽，先提供改光與場景修改
article.title_en: Microsoft previews MAI Image 2.7 for image editing, with generation still to come
article.summary: Microsoft AI於10月27日公布MAI Image 2.7預覽，主打場景風格、光線、文字及符號修改與圖像修復；文字生成圖像功能仍列為即將推出。
article.summary_en: Microsoft AI announced the MAI Image 2.7 preview on October 27 for scene, lighting, text and symbol edits and image restoration. Text-to-image generation is still described as forthcoming.
article.why: 創意團隊可評估能否以既有素材製作變體。產品形狀、品牌字樣與文字準確度仍需逐張檢查，尤其涉及真實商品時。
article.why_en: Creative teams can evaluate variations of existing assets while checking product shapes, brand marks and text accuracy in every output.
article.next_step: 以已獲授權的測試素材比較改光、換場景及文字修改，保留原圖作人工對照。
article.next_step_en: Compare relighting, scene changes and text edits on authorized test assets, retaining originals for human comparison.

The initial preview focuses on editing; text-to-image is not yet part of the stated rollout.
article.detail:
Microsoft AI於10月27日公布MAI Image 2.7預覽，主打場景風格、光線、文字及符號修改與圖像修復；文字生成圖像功能仍列為即將推出。

Microsoft表示可於Arena、Artificial Analysis及MAI Playground試用圖像編輯。

現階段先提供編輯，文字生成圖像尚未同步推出。

創意團隊可評估能否以既有素材製作變體。產品形狀、品牌字樣與文字準確度仍需逐張檢查，尤其涉及真實商品時。

以已獲授權的測試素材比較改光、換場景及文字修改，保留原圖作人工對照。

預覽可用性須按平台確認；本刊未重現官方榜單分數，亦未聲稱能保證品牌或中文字準確。
article.detail_en:
Microsoft AI announced the MAI Image 2.7 preview on October 27 for scene, lighting, text and symbol edits and image restoration. Text-to-image generation is still described as forthcoming.

Microsoft names Arena, Artificial Analysis and MAI Playground as places to try editing.

The initial preview focuses on editing; text-to-image is not yet part of the stated rollout.

Creative teams can evaluate variations of existing assets while checking product shapes, brand marks and text accuracy in every output.

Compare relighting, scene changes and text edits on authorized test assets, retaining originals for human comparison.

Confirm preview access on each platform. Leaderboard scores were not reproduced, and brand or Chinese-text fidelity is not guaranteed.
